title: WEBTOON Ent. Narrows Losses in 1st Quarter 2026
content: WEBTOON Entertainment narrowed its losses in the first quarter of 2026, posting an operating loss of US$8.03 million — down from US$26.63 million in the same period a year earlier, a roughly 70% improvement. The company disclosed the results on May 11.
author: ANN

title: Nintendo Announces New Photo-Based Smartphone Game Pictonico!
content: Nintendo announced on Monday a new smartphone game titled Pictonico! , which will launch on May 28. The company streamed a trailer: The game is a free-to-start game that uses photos taken on players' phones to insert real people's faces into minigames.

title: Netflix’s Biggest Anime Breakout Returns for New Release Ahead of Season 2
content: There’s one anime has been an absolute breakout hit with Netflix ever since it made its debut in 2024, and it’s come back for a special new collaboration as fans continue to wait on its Season 2 comeback.

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Reveals First Look at New Blu-ray Release
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle is gearing up for its highly anticipated home video launch in Japan later this Summer, and a new preview has shown off a much closer look at the release.

title: 2 Years Later, Major Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms Season 3 Release Date With New Look
content: A major Isekai anime franchise is returning to Crunchyroll this Summer with a whole new season of episodes, and has confirmed the release date for Season 3 of the anime with a new look teasing more of what to expect.

title: Surprise Netflix Anime Spin-Off Has Begun (And It’s Not What You Think)
content: Netflix has certainly been devoting a lot of effort to becoming a mover and shaker within the anime realm, both by housing classic anime and creating original anime content of its own.

title: South Park Season 29 Confirms Release Date & Schedule With First Look
content: South Park has finally set a return date for the long running animated series as Comedy Central has announced the release date and schedule for Season 29 with a first look teaser. South Park made its grand return to TV screens last year with some big shake ups behind the scenes.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Hypes Final Season With New Thousand-Year Blood War Trailer
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is returning with its fourth and final season later this Summer, and has dropped a new trailer to help celebrate. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War brought Tite Kubo’s original Bleach manga back for a whole new generation of the anime nearly two decades after the first TV anime series…

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 (Final Season) Reveals New Trailer
content: The final season of BLEACH: TYBW Part 4, titled Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Final Part – The Calamity , revealed a new trailer on Tuesday. The series will debut in U.S. theaters from June 25 to June 29. It will then start broadcasting on Japanese TV in July 2026.
author: Anime Corner
